test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is **"Pionier."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Pioneer."** • The incorrect spelling in Option 3 has an extra **"i"** in it. • The correct spelling follows the **"ie" **rule, where** "i" **comes before **"e"** except after **"c."** • **"Pioneer"** means a person who is one of the first to develop an area of human knowledge, culture, etc. (मानवीय ज्ञान, संस्‍कृति आदि के क्षेत्र में अग्रणी व्‍यक्ति) • **Example**: *Yuri Gagarin was one of the **pioneers**__ of space exploration.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Abundant"** is spelled correctly and means **"plentiful" or "ample."** (बहुत बड़ी मात्रा में विद्यमान, यथेष्‍ट से अधिक; भरपूर) • **Option 2: "Ecstasy"** is spelled correctly and means **"intense joy or delight." **(तीव्र आनंद या प्रसन्नता) • **Option 4: "Engineer" **is spelled correctly and means** "a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works."** (इंजन, मशीन इत्यादि का डिज़ाइन तैयार करने, बनाने अथवा मरम्मत करनेवाला; अभियंता, इंजीनियर) 174:T69e, The correct answer is **"was puzzled."**
